atlases.prompt: Create ONE scientific educational photographic sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, SIX equally sized cells on pure white background, no lines, no text. One complete animal centered in each cell with 15 percent white safety margin. Realistic natural 2D photographic cutouts, child friendly, anatomically correct, never cartoon or 3D render. Each cell must clearly show different AGE, BODY SHAPE, fur/feather length, breed or posture, not mere recoloring. Keep same recognizable animal identity throughout. Animals healthy even lean; mildly muddy animals not distressed. Relative real size differences visible: juveniles occupy ~50% of cell height, adults ~75%. Order left to right top then bottom: tiny kitten with fluffy juvenile face; large adult Maine Coon with long fur; round stocky British Shorthair; lean healthy short-haired Siamese cat; scruffy adult tabby with a little dried mud on paws; clean well-groomed long-haired Persian cat. Every subject must read as domestic CAT. No other animals, no props, no humans. Wide canvas, exact 3x2 equal grid.
